Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: production landing-page product screenshot, desktop web dashboard, landscape 16:10 composition.
Create a refined, pixel-sharp personal cloud file storage WEB dashboard for Dropvia. Take only the general information architecture of Dropbox web (left navigation, global search, main files area), NOT Dropbox branding or its visual design. Our specific visual system: near-black midnight canvas #05060f, raised surfaces #0d101c and #141824, icy text #d8ecf8, secondary text #9da7ba, very fine cool-blue translucent separators, restrained inset frost edges, 16px panel corners, pill buttons, calm precise sans serif, generous but practical spacing. Only one violet #663af3 control: Upload. All other UI monochrome icy blue-grey.
Render the dashboard itself perfectly front-on, edge-to-edge in the image. No exterior background or device, no perspective, no dramatic shadows, no hero text or marketing. Top left small solid teardrop symbol and word Dropvia. Slim sidebar with Files selected, Shared, Recent, Trash; bottom small Settings. Main area top compact search field and profile initials AL. Heading All files with Upload and New folder controls. A small row of three tasteful folder tiles Documents, Photos, Projects. Under it an orderly file table with Name, Modified, Size. Rows: Weekend photos (folder), Project brief.pdf, Coast.jpg (tiny calm blue coastline thumbnail), Notes.txt, Portfolio.pdf. Show modest ordinary dates and file sizes, no storage plan or usage counters, no invitation labels, no security badges, no graphs. Select no rows. Keep the dashboard visually rich through careful hierarchy, materials and thumbnail detail, never redundant cards. Use exact short English labels and crisp legible text. This is one complete desktop dashboard asset, not a collage. High fidelity finished product UI.
Refinement: Refine this exact Dropvia dashboard screenshot. Keep its composition, dimensions, every English text label, table, typography, spacing and near-black palette unchanged. Change ONLY the icon treatment: the teardrop brand mark must be flat pale ice blue #d8ecf8, not purple; folder glyphs must be flat restrained blue-grey #9da7ba, not saturated cyan or 3D; PDF/file glyphs must be simple monochrome outlines with no red or Adobe logo. The Upload button is the only violet area. Everything else is strictly monochrome cool blue-grey, except the tiny existing natural coastline thumbnail. Keep all labels completely legible. Front-on screenshot, no extra frame.

Create the LIGHT THEME version of this exact Dropvia desktop web dashboard screenshot. Preserve the exact composition, dimensions, all English labels and file names, sidebar, search, three folder tiles, table and spacing. Change only theme colors/materials: canvas #f6f8fc, surfaces white #ffffff with very subtle cool-grey inset edges, text/teardrop #19263c, secondary text #56647a, lines rgba(36,61,98,.15). Folder/file icons restrained monochrome blue-grey, no bright colors, no third-party logos. Upload button stays violet #663af3 with white text. Keep the coastline thumbnail. Crisp finished UI, front-on edge-to-edge, no device/no exterior frame, no added slogans.

Small top header with hamburger, pale ice-blue teardrop + Dropvia and AL avatar. A full-width search field 'Search files…'. Heading 'All files'. One violet #663af3 Upload pill and neutral New folder button. Compact folder shortcuts Documents, Photos, Projects.
